title: How Do LLMs Route and Execute Multiple Prompt Requirements Through Attention and the KV Cache?
summary_zh: 為研究提案「Mechanistic Attribution of Prompt Requirements」所做的 146 篇文獻回顧，處理一個問題：當一段提示同時包含多項自然語言要求時，模型如何把它們分開、儲存並查閱。全文以三個層級組織 —— L1 要求與行為的對應、L2 經由注意力頭與 KV 條目的內部路由、L3 以介入建立的因果必要性。含 10 個指令遵循基準的 HuggingFace 連結與實際樣本資料。
summary_en: A 146-work literature review supporting the research proposal Mechanistic Attribution of Prompt Requirements, on how a model separates, stores and consults several natural-language requirements carried by one prompt. Organised at three levels: L1 requirement-to-behavior mapping, L2 internal routing through attention heads and KV entries, and L3 causal necessity established by intervention. Includes HuggingFace links and real sample rows for ten instruction-following benchmarks.
